items.summary: A nationwide campaign will be organized by Department of Financial Services (DFS) for the saturation of Financial Inclusion (FI) schemes and other key interventions at the Gram Panchayat (GP) & Urban Local Body (ULB) level. The campaign will run from 21.10.2026 to 31.12.2026 covering 2.70 lakh GPs and ULBs in the country. During this period, banks will conduct camps for the following activities:
items.title: Saturation Campaign of Financial Inclusion (FI) Schemes to Run from 21st October 2026 to 31st December 2026
